provenance_warning: This architecture was designed after the v2 historical result was inspected. It is research-only and cannot certify deployment.
time_contract: same passed bar-open to bar-close causality contract as Event Discovery v2

gate_definitions.EXHAUSTION: ATR percentile >= 0.65, range >= 1 ATR, absolute RSI centered >= 0.25, maximum wick fraction >= 0.35
gate_definitions.BB_REENTRY: previous exact Bollinger location outside [0,1], current returns inside, maximum wick >= 0.20
gate_definitions.EXTREME_BREAK: cross of prior 50-bar high or low, body fraction >= 0.50, volume ratio >= 1.00
gate_definitions.COMPRESSION_RELEASE: previous exact ATR percentile <= 0.35, range >= 1 ATR, Bollinger location outside [0,1], body fraction >= 0.45
gate_definitions.MOMENTUM_TURN: MACD histogram crosses zero, absolute signed body >= 0.03 ATR, volume ratio >= 1.00
gate_definitions.RSI_TURN: RSI crosses inward through +/-0.35 with MACD histogram changing in the same turn direction
gate_definitions.EXPANSION_SHOCK: range >= 1.25 ATR, body fraction >= 0.55, volume ratio >= 1.20
